bullets.text: Ayapakkam residents face a six-month drinking water shortage due to illegal groundwater theft, and the office should intervene to stop the theft and restore supply.
A newly built drinking water tank costing 16.75 lakhs in Murukkampattu village remains unused for three years, and the office must ensure it is made operational immediately.

stories.title: அயப்பாக்கத்தில் 6 மாதங்களாக குடிநீர் தட்டுப்பாடு: நிலத்தடி நீரை திருடி விற்பதால் மக்கள் பரிதவிப்பு
takeaways: Residents of Ayappakkam panchayat near Avadi have faced a severe drinking water shortage for six months.
Unauthorised commercial extraction and theft of local groundwater are exacerbating the crisis for citizens.

stories.title: ரூ.16.75 லட்சத்தில் கட்டிய குடிநீர் தொட்டி 3 ஆண்டாக பயன்பாட்டிற்கு வராத அவலம்
takeaways: A drinking water tank constructed for Rs 16.75 lakhs in Murukkampattu village remains unused for three years.
Local residents in Tiruttani continue to struggle for basic water supply despite government expenditure.
